source_version: First Edition statement; copyright 1971. Atheneum catalog record OL2561783M. Kingsport Press is the printer.
source_note: Converted from the supplied scan. The source has no publisher title page or printed ISBN. The copyright page states First Edition and copyright 1971; public catalog metadata associates the 203-page edition with Atheneum. Both maps and chemical diagrams are preserved as source images. The barely readable front and back jacket flaps are omitted at user request. No ISBN from a later edition has been assigned. The reading cover is the user-supplied replacement artwork; source edition metadata remains based on the 1971 scan.

source_completeness.evidence: PDF 1 is the jacket cover; PDF 11 and 12 are distinct overview and travel-route maps. PDF 3 is copyright, with no publisher title page in the scan. Body pages 3–203 are present.
source_completeness.missing: Publisher title page; no assertion that omitted blank leaves contain text.

metadata_record_overrides.evidence: Copyright page PDF 3 visibly prints Library of Congress catalog card number 73–139314; catalog record number retained in cached API provenance.

comments.layout: Chapter starts verified against source contents and rendered pages; body cutoff excludes ornamental branches. PDF 4 bottom cutoff excludes public-library stamp.
comments.edition: 1971 Atheneum catalog record has no ISBN. Copyright LCCN differs from catalog and is preserved from scan.
comments.scan_pixels: Rendered PDF overlays visibly corrupt print (e.g. PDF 78 above, PDF 111 final line). Exactly one full-page original scan is placed on every page; OCR and illustrations use its pixels directly.
comments.chemical_diagrams: PDF 212 original pixel crop includes complete indole and amine formulas and their explanatory paragraph; chapter prose remains reflowable on either side.
comments.footnotes: Three source footnotes on PDF 33, 42 and 47; footer boundaries checked against the scan.
comments.primary_ocr: Tesseract has fewer prose disagreements in the initial whole-book comparison (85 versus 124); Vision retains accents in front matter and reads small-cap chapter openings more consistently. Both are compared with English PP-OCRv4 and old PDF OCR before source review.
comments.running_headers: Fresh OCR body rows on all ordinary pages begin at y >= 0.094; header band lies above 0.083. This checked margin excludes garbled mixed-case headers that escaped uppercase detection.
